extracted.intended_audience: NIH grant applicants and peer reviewers (including prospective/early-career reviewers)
extracted.subtask_description: High-level portal guidance and resources from the NIH Center for Scientific Review for conducting, reporting on, and participating in NIH grant peer review (for both applicants and reviewers, including early-career reviewers and society recommendees).

rubrics_metrics.name: Report review integrity concerns
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prompt to report concerns about integrity in the review process; paired on the page with an invitation to report concerns about unfair review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report concerns about unfair review
rubrics_metrics.description: Report your concerns about unfair review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate prompt emphasizing the ability to report perceived unfairness in peer review decisions or conduct.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrity and fairness in review
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn more about integrity & fairness in review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High-level expectation that NIH peer review should adhere to principles of integrity and fairness; page links to additional information/resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adopt the Simplified Review Framework
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn about the new Simplified Review Framework.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notification that CSR has introduced a Simplified Review Framework; page directs users to learn details (framework likely defines how reviews and scores are structured).

rubrics_metrics.name: Revisions to the Fellowship review and application process
rubrics_metrics.description: Revisions to the NIH Fellowship Review and Application Process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Announcement that the fellowship review/application procedures have been revised; implies new/updated expectations and criteria for fellowship applications and their review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Early Career Reviewer (ECR) program participation and benefits
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn About the Benefits of CSR's Early Career Reviewer (ECR) Program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ECR program aims to educate qualified scientists without prior CSR review experience to develop skills as a reviewer and to provide experience that might make them more competitive applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the Assisted Referral Tool
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tool recommended/available on the CSR site—implies a procedural resource to assist with referral of applications to appropriate review groups or study sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant resources for planning, writing, and submitting
rubrics_metrics.description: For Applicants: Explore resources to assist in the planning, writing, and submitting of a successful application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CSR provides resources aimed at improving application quality and submission success (planning, writing, submission logistics).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer tools and guidance for reviewing, critiquing, and scoring
rubrics_metrics.description: For Reviewers: Explore tools and guidance for the successful reviewing, critiquing, and scoring of applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CSR offers reviewer-facing tools and guidance intended to support consistent, effective critiques and scoring of grant applications (implies procedural and quality criteria for reviews).

rubrics_metrics.name: Refer to the NIH Guide for Grants and Contracts for policy changes
rubrics_metrics.description: Refer to the NIH Guide for Grants and Contracts for recent policy changes. It is recommended that all NIH applicants subscribe to the NIH Guide in order to stay informed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expectation that applicants (and likely reviewers) keep abreast of NIH policy changes via the NIH Guide; subscription recommended.

rubrics_metrics.name: SBIR/STTR applicant step-by-step guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Advice for SBIR/STTR Applicants: Find step-by-step instructions to apply for SBIR and STTR grants along with contact touchpoints at each step.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific procedural guidance for SBIR/STTR applicants including stepwise instructions and contacts—implies standards for compliant submissions to those programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer recommendations via scientific societies
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewer Recommendations via Scientific Societies: Scientific societies may use our online portal to recommend scientists for service on review panels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mechanism for nominating/recommending potential reviewers; indicates one pathway for reviewer recruitment and selection.
